Officer's narrative
On the afternoon of the reported collision, I responded to a side-impact crash at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas.
Driver 2's vehicle entered the intersection and struck the driver's side of a sedan operated by Driver 1. Driver 1 was
seated behind the wheel when I arrived, and Passenger was also present in the vehicle. Both were checked at the
scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder, which fits the direction and force of the impact as I observed it.
No bystander reported seeing the collision, and no photographs of the scene were submitted to me. I found no other
report of this incident. Some of the damage to Driver 1's vehicle may not have resulted from this impact, and I could
not determine whether all of it occurred in this collision. I have no information about earlier damage to the vehicle.
Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the applicable policy.
